answer: Audits are recorded in grove, queued in vault, and raven publishes the wait time. A farm of 378 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. A farm of 1225 identities would post 2527 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
